spans.s:
mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं)
Near, proximate.
n. (-ण्ठं)
1 Space near a village or its boundary.
2 One of a horse's paces, his walk.
ind. (-ण्ठं)
Upon the neck, near the throat.
E.
उप near, कण्ठ the neck.

n. (-णं)
1 Apparatus, paraphernalia, as the vessels and offerings at a sacrifice.
2 Implements, machines.
3 The insignia of royalty.
4 Sauces, condiments.
5 Helping, assisting.
6 Object of art or science, fabricating, composing, &c.
7 Means of subsistence, any thing supporting life.
E.
उप implying command or help, कृ to make, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Performance of a preparatory rite before reading the

Vedas.
2

Immolation, sacrifice of an animal duly consecrated.
E.
उप and आङ् prefixed to कृ to do, affix, ल्युट्.

ind.
Close to the ear, into the ear, (whispered, &c.)
E.
उप near, कर्ण् the ear.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
Assisting, befriending, one who helps or befriends.
E.
उप before कृ to do, affix तृन्.

n. (-नं)
1 Preparing articles of food, medicine, &c.
2 Fabricating, making.
3 Substituting.
E.
उप and कल्पन making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Prepared, made.
2 Secondary, substituted.
E.
उप and कल्पित prepared.

m. (-रः)
1 Favour, protection, help, assistance.
2 Use, advantage.
3 A flower, &c. full blown.
4 Garlands suspended, at gateways, as an embellishment on festivals.
E.
उप near or over, कृ to make, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A friend, a protector, one who befriends.
E.
उप and कृ to do, ण्वुल aff.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Protection, assistance.
E.
उपकारक and त्व aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Beneficent, diligent in doing good.
E.
उपकार and पर diligent.

f. (-का)
1 A protectress, a governess.
2 A palace, a caravansera.
3 A kind of cake.
E.
उपकारी as below, &c. कन् affix, and the fem. form, or the fem. of उपकारक.

f. (-ता)
Aid, succour, protection.
E.
तल् added to उपकारिन्; also with त्व, उपकारित्व.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Helping, assisting, a benefactor.
2 Subsidiary, subservient.
E.
उपकार and इनि aff.

f. (-री)
A palace, a caravansera.
E.
उपकार aid, asylum, affixes अण and ङीप्.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Deserving assistance or favour.
f. (-र्य्या)
1 A king's house, a palace, a caravansera.
2 A tent.
E.
उपकार aid, &c. and ण्यत् aff.

f. (-ञ्चिः)
A plant, (Nigella Indica.)
E.
उप very, कुञ्च to be small, and कि aff.

f. (-का)
1 Small cardamoms: see एला.
2 A sort of fennel flower, (Nigella Indica, Rox.)
E.
वुन् affixed to the last.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Solitary, lonely, retired.
n. or ind. (-म्भं)
Near the water jar.
E.
उप and कुम्भ a jar.

f. (-ल्या)
1 A canal, a trench, a ditch.
2 Long pepper, (Piper longum.)
E.
उप near, कुल to accumulate, and क्यप् affix, fem. टाप्.

m. (-शः)
Gum-boil.
E.
उप before कुश to enclose, क aff.

m. (-यः)
A trough near a well for watering cattle.
E.
उप near, कूप a well, and जलाशय a place for water.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Benefited, assisted.
2 Done kindly or beneficently, rendered as assistance.
n. (-तं)
A favour, a benefit.
E.
उप before कृ to do, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Attended with evil omens, disastrous, calamitous.
m. (-तः)
1 A victim slain or to be slain.
2 A portent, a phaenomenon announcing calamity.
E.
उप and आङ् before कृत made.

f. (-तिः)
Aid, assistance, kindness.
E.
उप and कृ to do, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Beginning, one who begins.
E.
उप before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.

m. (-मः)
1 Deliberate commencement or undertaking; providing means, and anticipating consequences.
2 A beginning in general.
3 A particular ceremony preparatory to reading the

Vedas.
4

A stratagem.
5 A means, an expedient.
6 Trying the fidelity, &c. of a counsellor or friend.
7

Valor.
8

Practice of medicine, physicking.
9 Flight, retreat.
10 Approach.
E.
उप over, &c. क्रम to go, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Necessary, to be commenced or undertaken.
2 To be gone to or near.
E.
उप before क्रम to go, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
One who begins, &c. see उपक्रम.
E.
उप before क्रम to go, तृच् affix, with इट augment; also उपक्रत्तृ.

m. (-शः)
Censure, reproach.
E.
उप reproach, inferiority, क्रुश to cry, to sound, affix घञ्.

m. (-ष्टा)
1 An ass.
2 A reviler, a reprover.
E.
उप implying censure, क्रुश to cry, तृन् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Consecrated, dedicated, prepared or set apart for use.
E.
उप and कॢप्त made.

m. (-णः)
The sound of a lute.
E.
उप well, क्वण to sound, affix अपे or with घञ् affix उपक्वाण.

m. (-यः)
Loss.
E.
उप before क्षि to lose, affix अच्.

m. (-पः)
Poetical or figurative style or composition.
E.
उप and क्षिप to throw, affix घञ्.

m. (-णः)
A small number, less than a troop or number.
E.
उप and गण a troop.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Promised, agreed.
2 Near, approached, gone to.
2 Feeling, suffering, entertaining.
3 Becoming, being, become.
5 Having, obtained.
E.
उप with, गत gone, part. past. of गम to go.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Suffering, feeling.
2

Promised.
3

Approached, arrived.
4 Occurred, happened.
E.
उप and आङ् before गम to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Going to, gone to.
2 Feeling, suffering, (as sorrow, &c.)
3

Promising.
4

Possessing.
E.
उप before गम to go, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-न्धः)
Perfume.
E.
उप and गन्ध smell.

m. (-मः)
1 Agreement, promise.
2 Approach, approximation.
3 Suffering, feeling.
4 Acquaintance, society, intercourse.
5 Getting, having, obtaining.
E.
उप near, गम to go, and अच् aff.

m. (-मः)
1 Promise, agreement.
2

Approach.
3

Occurrence, arrival.
4 Feeling, suffering.
E.
उप near, आङ् before गम to come, अच् aff.

ind.
Near a mountain; also with टच् added उपगिरम्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Celebrated, proclaimed, sung, (by bards, &c.)
E.
उप and गीत sung.

f. (-तिः)
A variety of the Arya metre, a stanza of four lines, containing 12--15 and 12--15 syllabic instants.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be sung.
ind.
Having sung.
E.
उप before गै to sing, यत् or ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Hidden, concealed.
2 Lulled, suppressed.
E.
उप before गुह to hide, affix क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 An embrace, embracing.
2 Astonishment, surprise.
E.
उप near, गुह to hide, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-हः)
1 A prisoner, a man or animal in confinement.
2 Favour, encouragement.
3

Assistance.
4

Peace purchased by the cession of every thing.
5

Seizure.
6

The presiding spirit or cause directing a planet's motion.
7 A minor planet or any heavenly body of a secondary kind, as a comet, a meteor, a falling star, &c.
8 A heap of kusa grass.
E.
उप near, ग्रह to take, अप् affix or ग्रह a planet, &c.

n. (-णं)
1 Taking, seizing.
2 Holy study, reading the Vedas after initiation.
E.
उप much, ग्रह to take, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-णं)
Reading the Vedas after initiation.
E.
उप and आङ् before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् affix: see उपाकरण.

m. (-ह्यः)
A present, an offering to a king or great man, a Nezer.
E.
उप much, &c. ग्रह to take, affix ण्यत्.

m. (-तः)
1 Disease, sickness.
2 Touch, contact, especially with an intent to injure.
3 Personal violence, assault.
E.
उप much, हन to injure, घञ् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
1 Contiguous support.
2 Support, stay, protection.
3 What rests upon or is supported by.
E.
उप near, हन to destroy, and अप् aff.

m. (-क्रः)
A variety of the ruddy goose.
E.
उप minor, and चक्र the Cakra.

m. plu. (-राः)
Almost four.
E.
उप and चतुर four.

m. (-यः)
1 Quantity, heap.
2

Elevation.
3

Prosperity.
4

Excess.
5

The third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh degrees from the first of a zodiacal sign.
E.
उप above, चि to collect, अच् aff.

m. (-य्यः)
A place for holding sacrificial fire, a hearth, an altar.
E.
उप, चिञ् to collect, ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Served, adored.
E.
उप near or with, चर to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be served or waited on.
f. (-र्य्या)
1 Service, attendance.
2 Practice of medicine, physicking.
E.
उप implying help, चर to go, क्यप् and टाप् affs.

m. (-र्य्यः)
Practice of medicine.
E.
उप, चर in the causal form, and ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-रः)
1 Service, attendance.
2 Physicking, the practice of medicine.
3 Practice, profession, usage.
4 A present, a bribe.
5 Presenting delicacies or necessaries, water, betel. [] &c.
6 Tending the sick, nursing.
7 Solicitation, request.
8 Incomplete, act, one in progress.
9 A form of speech, a phrase that leaves something to be inferred, ellipsis, &c.
E.
उप well. much, &c. चर to go, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Offering presents, especially of perfumes. flowers, &c. attention, service.
E.
उपचार and करण making; also उपचारकर्म्मन्, उपचारक्रिया, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Waiting upon, serving diligently.
E.
उपचार service, and पर diligent.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Collected, assembled.
2

Heaped.
3

Thriving, increasing.
4

Burnt.
5

Plaistered, smeared.
E.
उप much, and चित collected, from चिञ् to gather, affix क्त.

f. (-त्रा)
A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) see मूषिकपर्णी
E.
उप much, चित्र variegated.

n. (-नं)
Heathing, burning.
E.
उप much, चूर to burn, affix ल्युट्, र changed to ल.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be collected or heaped up.
E.
उप before चि to gather, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Secret, concealed.
E.
उप and छद to cover, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Produced, engendered, aroused.
E.
उप and जात born.

f. (-तिः)
A metre or stanza of four lines, with eleven syllables in each.

m. (-पः)
1 Disunion, separation.
2 Treason, treachery.
E.
उप separation, जप to meditate, ण aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A mischief-maker, one who foments quarrels.
2 A traitor, treacherous.
E.
उप before जप to meditate, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-ह्वा)
1 A kind of insect.
2 The uvula or soft palate.
3 Enlargement of the tongue.
E.
उप privation or similitude, and जिह्वा the tongue.

f. (-का)
1 A species of insect.
2 The soft palate: see the preceding.

n. (-कं)
1 Act, object.
2 Means of subsistence.
E.
उप before जीव to live, वुन् aff.

f. (-का)
Subsistence, livelihood.
E.
उप and जीविका the same.

n. (-नं)
Subsistence, means of living.
E.
उप and जीवन living.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Dependant, living by or on.
E.
उप and जीविन् who lives.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Affording a livelihood.
n. (-व्यं)
Cause.
E.
उप before जीव to live, य aff.

ind.
An expression indicative of joy.
E.
उप much, जुष to be kind, and अम् affix; also उपयोषम्.

f. (-ज्ञा)
Untaught knowledge.
E.
उप near, with ज्ञा knowledge, from ज्ञा to know, अङ्, and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
A respectful offering or present, a Nezer.
E.
उप and ढौकन seeking.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Heated, parched.
2 Distressed, pained.
E.
उप and तप्त heated.

m. (-प्ता)
1 Morbid heat.
2 Any cause of heat, burning or inflammation.
E.
उप excess, तप to heat, तृच् aff.

Disease.
2

Haste, hurry.
3 Heat, heatedness.
4

Pain.
5

Misfortune.
E.
उप much, तप to heat, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
1 Inflaming, exciting.
2

Heating.
3

Suffering heat or pain.
4 Sick.
E.
उपताप and इनि affix, or उप before तप with णिनि aff.

f. (-का)
Land near the foot of a hill or mountain.
E.
उप near, त्यकन् aff.

n. (-शः)
1 A relish, or something to promote drinking.
2 The venereal disease, chancre.
3 Biting, stinging.
4 A tree, the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish, (Morunga hyperanthera).
E.
उप much, &c. दंश biting.

m. (-कः)
1 A doorkeeper.
2 A guide.
E.
उप and दर्शक who shews.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Perceived, distinguished.
E.
उप before दर्शित seen.

f. (-दा)
A present, an offering to a king or great man, &c. a Nezer.
E.
उप, दा a gift, from दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.

n. (-कं)
A present, &c. see the preceding.
E.
उप implying help, &c. दान a gift, and क affix: a gift which is for the purpose of procuring favour or protection.

ind.
Having advised or instructed.
E.
उप before दिश to shew, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Instructed, advised.
2

Initiated.
3

Specified, particularised.
4 Assigned as a plea or reason.
n. (-ष्टं)
Council, advice.
E.
उप before दिश to shew, क्त aff.

f. (-दी)
A parasitic plant.

f. (-ता)
A minor divinity, as a Yakṣa, Gandharba, Apsaras, &c.
E.
उप and देवता a divinity.

m. (-शः)
Advice, information, instruction.
3 Plea, pretext.
4

Specification.
5

Initiation, communication of the initiatory Mantra or formula.
6 (In grammar,) An elementary term.
E.
उप before दिश to shew, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Giving instruction, instructing, instructive.
m. (-कः)
An instructor, a guide, specially a spiritual guide.
E.
उप before दिश to shew, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
Advising, instructing.
E.
उप before दिश to shew, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Advising, an adviser.
E.
उपदेश advice, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be advised, (fit, proper, &c.)
E.
उप before दिश to shew, तव्य affix; also उपदेश्य, उपदेशनीय.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
One who points out, who orders or advises.
m. (-ष्टा)
A Guru, a spiritual guide.
E.
उप prefixed to दिश to shew, affix तृच्.

m. (-हः)
1 Liniment, ointment.
2 A minor or secondary body.
E.
उप and दिह plaster, or देह the body.

f. (-का)
A kind of insect.
E.
उप with, &c. देह the body, affixes कन् and टाप्; also उत्पादिका.

m. (-वः)
1 Tyranny, oppression.
2 National distress, whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c.
3 National commotion, rebellion.
4

Violence.
5

A supervenient [] disease, one brought one whilst a person labours under another.
E.
उप, द्रु to go, अच् aff.

Tyrannical.
2

Violent, factious.
m. (-वी)
1 A tyrant, an oppressor.
2 A rebel.
E.
उपद्रव and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Supervisor, inspector, overseeing, overlooking.
E.
उप before दृश to see, तृच् affix, the vowel changed to र.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tyrannized over, oppressed, visited by calamities, &c.
E.
उप before द्रु to go, क्त aff.

m. (-र्म्मः)
1 A heretic, a schismatic.
2 A minor or inferior duty.
E.
उप and धर्म्म duty.

f. (-धा)
1 A false pretence.
2 Trial or test of honesty, &c. of four kinds, of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage.
3 A penultimate letter.
E.
उप, धा having, from धा, to have, with अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-तुः)
1 An inferior mineral, a semi-metal: seven are specified; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpiment, and calx of brass.
2 Secondary secretion, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph.
E.
उप minor, and धातु mineral, &c.

n. (-नं)
1 A pillow.
2 Kindness, affection.
3

Poison.
4

Religious observance or obligation.
5 Excellence, excellent quality.
6 Resting or placing upon.
E.
उप, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-यं)
A pillow.
E.
उपधान a pillow, and छ aff.

ind.
Having placed or rested upon.
E.
उप before धा to hold, ल्युप् aff.

mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि)
Approved, tried, of approved loyalty, &c.
E.
उपधा and शुचि pure.

m. (-धिः)
1 Fraud, circumvention.
2 The wheel of a carriage.
3 Fear, terror.
E.
उप, धा to have, and कि aff.

m. (-धिः)
1 Virtuous reflection.
2 A discriminative or distinguishing property, an attribute.
3 Deception, disguise. (In the Vedānta this is especially applied to certain natural forms or properties, considered as disguises of the spirit.)
4 A title, a discriminative appellation, a nickname.
5 Careful or diligent for the support of a family, (always masculine, though with a feminine or neuter substantive.)
6 A purpose, an occasion, an object.
7 (In logic,) A special cause for a general effect.
3 (In rhetoric,) The natural character of species, quality, or action.
E.
उप and आङ् before धा to have, affix कि.

m. (-कः)
1 A cheat, a knave, especially one who extorts money by threats.
2 Fraud.
E.
उपधि and कृ to make, ड aff. or कन् pleonasm.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Being at the point of death.
2 Suffering extreme pain.
E.
उप near or much, धूपित pained.

f. (-तिः)
A ray of light.
E.
उप much, धृ to have, क्तिन् affix.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Approached, approximate, near, (either in time or place.)
E.
उप near, नम to bow, affix क्तः.

m. (-यः)
The initiation of the three first classes; investiture with a peculiar thread or cord worn over the left shoulder, and under the right: the cord of the Brahman is of cotton, Munja, or Kusa grass; of the Kṣatriya, of Śaṇa or flax; and of the Vaiśya, of wool: the youths should be invested, respectively, from eight to sixteen, from eleven to twenty-two, and from twelve to twenty-four years of age.
n. (-नं)
1 Attaining, gaining.
2 Bringing to.
E.
उप over, णीञ्^1 to obtain, अच् affix; also with घञ् affix उपनाय, and with ल्युट् affix उपनयन.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 314. note: Cf WIL and WIL1819 णी.

m. (-यः)
See उपनय.

n. (-नं)
